the-registry-and-retained-identity-outpu.text: The registry and retained identity outputs. An owner parks while retaining the output, token, minimum ADA and key state, and returns through rotation with fresh bonds. Consumers refuse parked and pending outputs. These are model guarantees, not production conformance. Earlier replaced claims remain in the historical design record.

where-the-registry-is-built.text: The model imports public Singular commit d69ab005c3b710aeebf033d3c5cd08c56feb5643 under Lean 4.27.0. Registry projects its carriers and pending entries to the actual imported world. It executes booking and economic folds, then checks that reconstruction agrees. Public upstream product requirements and executable model evidence remain separate.

the-machine-registrylean.text: The machine stores generation, configuration, trie, carriers, bookings, whole termination entries, treasury and permanent bindings. Registration creates a carrier only through an accepted fold. Park returns the bond and retains the carrier. Revive rotates locally and deposits a fresh bond. Conviction leaves pending custody. Booking records the complete request and carrier association; only a consuming fold completes retirement. Generic recovery uses the full imported transaction. Registry evidence is coarse. Carrier original is a stable provenance descriptor, not an equality with the evolving serialized Checkpoint datum or current ledger reference. The coarse counter and concrete key encoding are not universally equated.

what-registration-guarantees.text: On reachable states, the model preserves unique custody and permanent bindings. A second first-registration cannot replace an active or retired key. Parking and revival keep the token. An active key alone is not consumer authority. Concrete token bytes, canonical registry and transaction authentication remain separate obligations.

checkpoint-and-the-associated-system.text: Checkpoint owns concrete duplicity, signed intent, bonds, pool, poison, freeze and juvenility. Close refunds remaining bonds and pool while retaining the output and key state. Revival needs a later rotation from that state and fresh bonds. The associated system retains the actual registered origin and whole pending entry. Its certificate replays the stored context and consumes the exact request. Another valid request cannot complete this identity. The system player shows both flows and full states.

booking-and-fold-economics.text: Booking requires request minimum ADA plus tip to fit in carrier minimum ADA. The request receives that sum, the booker receives the remainder, and the fee is external. Parking retains minimum ADA and cannot also pay it away. Registration delivers declared carrier ADA, destination and datum to the token-bearing output and sends registration cost to treasury. Termination has no carrier output: request ADA less declared tip goes to treasury, equal to request minimum ADA for a matching KERI booking. Tips are ordinary value governed by accounting, not an automatic named payment. Self-fold accounting requires its exact matching, address, output and fee premises. Profit is conditional.

executable-evidence-and-limits.text: The Registry and Checkpoint pages replay complete generated observations, with an associated-system player for receipts. Kernel proofs, finite executions, model mutants and checker controls are different evidence. Source bindings belong to the candidate. Production construction, submission, rollback, live availability, cryptographic codecs and broader request recovery require their own correspondence and implementation tests.
